description: Capella's manage-xdcr-replications.md documents a 'Filter Binary Documents' checkbox, gated on source/target Server 7.2.2+, as part of XDCR filtering configuration. None of the five filtering-family reference pages under server/8.0/xdcr-reference/ mention binary-document filtering or its version gate at all - a one-way documentation asymmetry where the Capella guide states a capability the Server reference manual for the same feature omits.
